data.body: The ComfyUI conversion left four per-family registries unaware of comfyui.<id>, each a separate hard failure: (1) native document catalog is_tool_binding_id; (2) stored frozen-binding integrity predicate in history.rs (builtin-or-mcp only) -> "stored frozen Chat tool bindings failed integrity validation" on every message; (3) freeze_graph_bindings tested the comfyui. prefix before the exact authoring-helper ids, silently dropping comfyui.get_workflow/list_node_types from every Chat (tool_loop.rs had the right order); (4) editor/native prefix drift. All fixed. Rule: a new capability family must be added to every family-list registry on the freeze, validate, admit, dispatch and stored-record paths - grep prefix comparisons and builtin_tool_binding_ids. New tests bind freeze_graph_bindings output to validate_frozen_tool_bindings. All 116 stored frozen Chats in the real profile still validate.
